Mercurius sulphuricus    (Sulphate of Mercury. Turpeth mineral.)



Merc. sulph.   will
        sometimes help, when you have a case of hydrothorax with quick, short breathing, etc., and
        burning of the chest.


If you go to an old case of hypostatic congestion, with dropsy, or a case
        of dyspnoea from hydrothorax, when the   Merc  . base is present. you will be astonished at the
        action of this sulphate.
